title: Rewind E2E functional validation (functional-tester)
objective: Validate etl4/orchestration/rewind.py (T-21) end-to-end across 7 scenarios without touching production data. Produce a report with per-scenario PASS/FAIL, defect list, and 1-line patch recommendations.

scenarios.name: Dry-run on empty state
scenarios.notes: literal command (no --yes) exits 1; with --yes --dry-run plan prints full chain; no sandbox writes. INFO finding D-27-2.

scenarios.name: Single-layer vault rewind
scenarios.notes: Jan+Feb removed, Mar survives, both vault wms rolled to 2018-12.

scenarios.name: Full-stack --layer all downstream-first chain
scenarios.notes: Call-order spy confirms eval_mart -> matrix -> sink -> marts -> vault; each downstream layer already wiped at precondition entry of next.

scenarios.name: Cross-month flight rewind M then M+1
scenarios.notes: FS half passes; Postgres half NOT TESTABLE (no fact_flight postgres sink exists). HIGH finding D-27-1 (mitigation (b) unimplemented).

scenarios.name: --help mentions cross-month rule
scenarios.notes: epilog= in rewind.py line 547 carries the note; string checks confirm 'cross-month' and 'M+1'.

scenarios.name: Idempotent repeat rewind
scenarios.notes: Run 2 returns dirs=0 bytes=0 watermarks_reset=0, exit 0.

scenarios.name: dim_aircraft never rolled back
scenarios.notes: rows, watermark, monolith st_mtime_ns all unchanged post sink+marts rewind.

defects.summary: No cross-month SQL detection snippet or warning on live rewind_vault; ADR 2026-11-20 (b) requires one.
--layer all --dry-run without --yes exits 1 before printing the plan; dry_run should short-circuit the yes-gate.
defects.patch: swap two if branches in rewind_all

defects.summary: Production fact_trajectory_enriched lacks the ym column; rewind_sink works only in dry-run against prod. Already tracked by T-13.

acceptance_criteria.statement: All 7 scenarios have an explicit PASS/FAIL recorded with evidence
No production vault / marts filesystem tree touched
acceptance_criteria.evidence: every call passes root=<scratch>; scratch under temp dir; verified no prod silver_vault/gold_marts paths appear in driver log

acceptance_criteria.statement: No production Postgres table rows mutated
acceptance_criteria.evidence: sandbox schema t27_sandbox created with hand-written DDL and dropped; public.dim_aircraft count 149747 pre+post; pipeline_watermarks prod rows unchanged (2 prod rows, same last_ym values)

acceptance_criteria.statement: pytest etl4/tests/ -q green before and after
Windows cp1252-safe stdout (no arrows, no em-dashes) in driver + report
acceptance_criteria.evidence: grep for non-cp1252 glyphs in both files returned zero hits

acceptance_criteria.statement: Defect list with severity and 1-line patch for every finding
acceptance_criteria.evidence: D-27-1 HIGH + D-27-2 MEDIUM + D-27-3 MEDIUM(ref-only)

pass=7 fail=0 error=0 after Sc4 fix (initial run surfaced test-code bug evaluating feb_sfs.is_file() after Feb rewind; fixed by capturing state into local before second rewind)

production_issues_found: D-27-1 cross-month warning absent in live rewind stdout
D-27-3 confirms T-12 known gap: public.fact_trajectory_enriched.ym missing
notes: Driver applies isolation lessons from advisor review: sandbox Postgres schema (search_path DSN set BEFORE import so DSN_DEFAULT binds), __kwdefaults__ patch for in-process root isolation, call-order spies instead of stdout parsing, prod shape (no ym on fact_trajectory_enriched) reproduced before the ALTER for Sc3/Sc6 to expose the T-12 gap. The dispatch's Sc3 ordering claim (matrix -> sink -> eval_mart -> marts -> vault) is loose; code order (eval_mart first) is correct under downstream-first because fact_experiment_result materializes MAX(ym) over pipeline_runs.
